title: Extra time and special help in a school
body: A class is discussing whether some decisions taken in their school are just. Suresh, a visually impaired student, is given three hours and thirty minutes to finish his mathematics paper, while the rest of the class gets three hours. Geeta, who walks with a limp, has also been given thirty extra minutes by her teacher. Another teacher gives grace marks to the weaker students in her class to boost their morale. A professor gives different question papers to different students based on her own evaluation of their capabilities. The class notes that physical disability, age and lack of access to good education or health care are often accepted as grounds for special treatment, but that it is not always easy to agree which inequalities deserve special help.
